text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum underperforming slightly, while altcoins like BNB and SOL hold steadier—a typical pattern when capital gravitates toward the majors. The Fear & Greed index sits at 69 (Greed) with no directional shift over a week, suggesting cautious optimism without conviction, paired with Bitcoin dominance at 58.3% indicating some rotation into alternative assets. Volume at $89B is moderate, neither flush nor thin, consistent with a consolidation phase rather than a decisive break in either direction.
